Pick a legitimately obtained ZIP file or folder. You can review and verify guessed document types before saving.
Streams and packages all saved records for the currently selected Upazila into a structured ZIP file with a manifest.tsv.

IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER:

LandArchive BD is an UNOFFICIAL, independent utility application. It is NOT affiliated with, authorized by, or associated with the Directorate General of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), Ministry of Land, Aspire to Innovate (a2i), or any government body of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh.

All land records, khatians, and mouza maps must be officially certified and verified at the local Upazila Land Office (AC Land) or District Record Room. This tool does not perform automatic crawling, does not automate or bypass CAPTCHAs, does not host records, and stores only files downloaded or imported directly by the user on local device storage.
